backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing admin authentication with fixed credentials, user profiles, product management, orders, recharge orders, bills, and blob storage with access control and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that preserves adminPassword state during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and styles for a grocery store PWA with admin panel.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color palette defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with warm earthy tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, manifest link, and app icons for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and standalone display mode for the grocery store application.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls with cache fallback.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin, billing, and settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization component that verifies admin access via Internet Identity and displays a login dialog for admin ID/password authentication with error handling and principal display.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload. Includes validation, duplicate barcode checking, and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality. Includes loading skeletons and confirmation dialog for product deletion.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Shows searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality. Includes filtering by bill number, customer name, or phone.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template with shop details, customer info, itemized list, and totals in a thermal printer-friendly 80mm format.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer displaying cart items with quantities, prices, and checkout/clear actions. Includes swipe-to-close gesture support for mobile.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable list of category filter buttons for product browsing with active state highlighting.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information (free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with shop information, contact details, Google Maps link, delivery info, and attribution to caffeine.ai platform.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with navigation, cart drawer toggle, and Internet Identity login/logout functionality. Displays store logo, navigation links, cart item count badge, and authentication button.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that provides the page structure with Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and a main content area with gradient background.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Mobile recharge form component with operator selection, mobile number input, and amount fields. Validates input and submits recharge orders through the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Payment QR code display component showing the amount to pay, a QR code image, and step-by-step UPI payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, category badge, price, and an add-to-cart button with authentication check.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product grid component with category filtering that displays all products in a responsive grid layout with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication provider and hook managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity state, and login status tracking with React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including products, cart management, orders, recharge orders, bills, and authentication with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Empty hook file with no content.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a warm, earthy color palette (browns, creams, oranges) for both light and dark modes, plus touch-friendly button styles and print styles for 80mm thermal bill printing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying statistics (products, orders, bills, revenue) with tabs for managing products, orders, recharge orders, and bill history, plus navigation to billing and settings pages.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for customizing shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template and display of fixed shop information.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Admin billing interface supporting camera or manual barcode scanning to add products to a bill, with customer details input and bill generation/printing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page collecting delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculating total with delivery fees, and placing orders with validation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page displaying a hero banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing order ID, payment QR code, next steps instructions, and options to continue shopping or call the store.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: React component displaying store information including contact details, location map, delivery policy, store hours, and services for 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point'.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking a pending feature request to change admin login ID to '97SKY80' in the backend authentication system.
